items.title: 68087_Cliff Leeman oral history interview
items.q: I went for a very short time on the road with Jimmy Dorsey... We had been drinking buddies, also, at the time of my association with his orchestra.

ctx.x: He got credit for one of those Muzak things. Because when Kirby went back, he played against Duke Ellington, and I had gone home - that's when I went home. That gig was over, and I went for a very short time on the road with Jimmy Dorsey, which was a bad experience, because he was sick and I just mentioned that I went with Jimmy Dorsey three or four months.
And then around -- what year did you go into --
